test_error_codes: test that each AndroidEnv error class has the correct ERROR_CODE integer value

test_all_errors_are_androidenv_errors: test that every error subclass is an instance of AndroidEnvError base class

test_from_code: test that from_code constructs the correct error instance with the given message for known codes
